summary: This video provides a practical overview of mass air flow (MAF) sensors commonly found in modern fuel-injected engines. It explains the sensor’s role in measuring air volume and density to help the engine computer balance air and fuel, outlines common symptoms of a failing or dirty sensor (including hard starts, reduced fuel economy, hesitation, and a check engine light with code P0101), and describes common failure modes such as intake leaks and dirty air filters. It also demonstrates basic diagnostics concepts (using basic tools or an OBD scanner), and presents a hands-on cleaning procedure using dedicated MAF cleaner, with cautions against improper cleaning techniques and irreversible damage. The video emphasizes safety, proper reassembly checks, and ECU reset steps after servicing the sensor.
